FIND: Dead parameter `prior_observations` in `observe()` is never used, silently ignoring passed prior observations.
FALSIFIER:
```python
import macrophage_cell
from macrophage_cell import MacrophageObservation, MacrophageSummary

cell = macrophage_cell.MacrophageCell(mode="test")
dummy_obs = MacrophageObservation(
    observation_id="0", mode="test", category="test",
    description="test", severity=0.5, evidence={}, is_anomaly=False
)

summary1 = cell.observe(verdicts=[], prior_observations=[dummy_obs])
summary2 = cell.observe(verdicts=[], prior_observations=None)

def normalize_obs(obs):
    return MacrophageObservation(
        observation_id=None,
        mode=obs.mode,
        category=obs.category,
        description=obs.description,
        severity=obs.severity,
        evidence=obs.evidence,
        is_anomaly=obs.is_anomaly,
    )

summary1_norm = MacrophageSummary(
    summary_id=None,
    mode=summary1.mode,
    observations=[normalize_obs(o) for o in summary1.observations],
    summary_text=summary1.summary_text,
)
summary2_norm = MacrophageSummary(
    summary_id=None,
    mode=summary2.mode,
    observations=[normalize_obs(o) for o in summary2.observations],
    summary_text=summary2.summary_text,
)

if summary1_norm == summary2_norm:
    raise AssertionError("FALSIFIED: prior_observations parameter has no effect (unused)")
```
